channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: A dramatic bear hunt in a midsize Japanese city could be a harbinger of what is to come
item.description: Utsunomiya's dramatic three-day ordeal with an at-large bear could be a mere sign of what's to come for Japanese cities.

item.title: Not so cozy? Japanese bookstore fiction gets real.
item.description: Translated Japanese fiction is obsessed with quiet stories taking place in bookshops and cafes, but life and work in Japan is not as idyllic as it seems.

item.title: Replies mentioning foreign citizens surge on Takaichi’s X account
item.description: In some cases, comments against immigrants were repeated even when the prime minister did not mention policies pertaining to foreign nationals.

item.title: James Suckling’s Great Wines World Tokyo marks its third edition
item.description: Curated by influential wine critic James Suckling, the event offers a rare opportunity to taste more than 260 top-rated wines from 130 producers.

item.title: Japan is known for world-class events - but the Asian Games were chaotic
item.description: Hotel chaos, transport mishaps and diplomatic blunders cast a spotlight on organisers and the firm hired to deliver the games.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
